post_caption:
I’ve only been able to use one haircare brand on my sensitive scalp up until now. i know you’re thinking “girl this is sponsored, i don’t trust you” well nobody’s holding you hostage. Anyways if you’ve chosen to listen to what i have to say, this isn’t taking my number one spot but it is an option if my first isn’t available, which gives me more of a choice.

Unfortunately this shampoo didn’t emulsify well and I found I had to use a lot more than what I usually do and I don’t really like fragran
